title: AI Gameplan Week 2: Content and Automation
tagline: Make it work for you. Build a sports content system with AI support and proof.

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Sports Brand Audit

video.title: How To Use Google Drive
video.purpose: Use Drive to save screenshots and audit proof.

lessons.goal: Reagan audits a college athletics social account and learns what strong sports content does.
sections: Pick the account
Choose one college athletics department or team account. Use public information only.
Audit the basics
Review bio, pinned posts, last 10 posts, video usage, graphics, calls to action, and fan engagement.
Use AI the right way
Ask Claude to organize your notes, not invent facts. Paste only public observations.
Submit
Turn in a one page audit with 3 strengths, 3 misses, and 3 fixes.

quiz.q: What should AI do in the audit?

lessons.checkpoint: I can show proof for sports brand audit.

visuals.title: Audit with proof
visuals.note: Every recommendation needs a screenshot, link, or clear observation.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Content Calendar
lessons.goal: Reagan builds a 5 day content calendar for a sports brand.
sections: Define the audience
Write who the content is for: athletes, parents, fans, recruits, students, or alumni.
Pick the pillars
Use 4 pillars: educate, spotlight, promote, and humanize.
Build the week
Create 5 posts with platform, hook, caption idea, visual idea, and goal.
Submit
Turn in the calendar plus one note explaining why each post belongs.

quiz.q: What does a content pillar do?

choices: One clear audience, one clear message, one clear action

lessons.checkpoint: I can show proof for content calendar.

visuals.title: Calendar system
visuals.note: A strong calendar explains audience, goal, hook, and proof.

lessons.title: Lesson 3: AI Assisted Copy
lessons.goal: Reagan writes sports captions with AI help while keeping human judgment in charge.
sections: Start with context
Give the AI sport, audience, tone, goal, facts, and constraints.
Draft three ways
Create one hype version, one parent friendly version, and one professional version.
Human pass
Remove generic phrases. Make it sound like a real person wrote it.
Submit
Turn in 3 captions and explain which one you would use.

quiz.q: What makes an AI copy prompt better?

choices: Reagan with CJ review when public

lessons.checkpoint: I can show proof for ai assisted copy.

visuals.title: Human copy pass
visuals.note: AI can draft. Rea still has to decide if it is true, clear, and useful.

lessons.title: Lesson 4: Clip Ideas and Repurposing
lessons.goal: Reagan turns one long sports video or article into short content ideas without rehosting outside videos.
sections: Pick source material
Use a public YouTube video, article, or team post. Do not download or rehost outside video.
Find moments
Identify 5 moments that could become clips, quote cards, or carousel posts.
Write hooks
Write a hook, title, and caption angle for each moment.
Submit
Turn in 5 clip ideas with source links and timestamps when available.

choices: Clipping and rehosting outside videos without rights

quiz.q: What makes a clip idea useful?

lessons.checkpoint: I can show proof for clip ideas and repurposing.

visuals.title: Clip idea board
visuals.note: Use source links and timestamps. Do not rehost what we do not own.

lessons.title: Lesson 5: Simple Automation Map
lessons.goal: Reagan designs one safe automation map for a content workflow.
sections: Pick the repeatable job
Choose one job: collect links, draft captions, save screenshots, or build a weekly report.
Map inputs and outputs
Write what starts the automation, what tools it touches, and what the final output should be.
Add safety rules
No public posting, no private data, and human review before anything goes out.
Submit
Turn in a one page automation map with trigger, steps, owner, proof, and safety rules.

quiz.q: What must every public automation include?
What is the safest first automation?

lessons.checkpoint: I can show proof for simple automation map.

visuals.title: Automation map
visuals.note: A safe automation drafts, saves, and asks for review.

lessons.title: Lesson 6: Week 2 Project, Social Media System
lessons.goal: Reagan packages the audit, calendar, captions, clip ideas, and automation map into one sports social system.
sections: Assemble the system
Create a Week 2 folder with audit, calendar, captions, clip ideas, automation map, and proof.
Write the explanation
Answer: How would I run social for a college athletics department?
Back it up
Upload the folder to Drive and export course progress.
Submit
Turn in Drive link, final write up, and closeout note.

quiz.q: What is the Week 2 final product?
What should the final write up explain?
choices: How Reagan would run social for a college athletics department

lessons.checkpoint: I can show proof for week 2 project, social media system.

visuals.title: Week 2 package
visuals.note: One folder. Clear proof. Ready for CJ review.

qualityRules: Every content deliverable must include source links or screenshots.
No public posting without CJ approval.
AI drafts are not final until Reagan does a human pass.
Every week ends with Drive backup and closeout.
